description.value: Saray Turkish Cuisine is a full-service Turkish restaurant in Burnaby seating up to 120 guests, serving traditional dishes like Iskender Kebab, Adana Kebab, Meze Platters, and Pide, exclusively using Halal meat. The restaurant offers a loyalty rewards program for online orders. On Friday evenings, the dining room hosts live music with a vocalist, kanun player, and drummer.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (3 spaces) at 57m. Total: 3 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms this is an active Turkish restaurant at 6633 Hastings St, Burnaby, BC V5B 1S1. The website explicitly offers takeout/delivery and lists Veggie Kebab and Veggie Pide on the menu, confirming vegetarian options. No bike parking, water refill, or washroom information appears anywhere in the website content; OSM tags also lack these. Two concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' while the website consistently says Burnaby, and the OSM email (sarayturkish@gmail.com) differs from the website email (info@sarayturkish.com).
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website consistently identifies the location as Burnaby, BC (postal code V5B 1S1 is a Burnaby code). The OSM community tag may be incorrectly assigned.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with a fully operational website and online ordering. A straightforward include for a touring cyclist seeking a meal.
